integration_issues.flow: Create Production Order with a multi-option Source of Supply (HTBS-SPAIN, 2 valid Production Model/Site combos)
integration_issues.issue: NOT FIXED (iteration_92 MEDIUM, now HIGH). Root cause: `const selectedSosOption = sosOptions[Number(selectedSosKey)];` (ProductionConfirmationPage.js ~line 514). With nothing picked selectedSosKey is "" and Number("") === 0, so selectedSosOption resolves to sosOptions[0] (truthy). Effects: (1) the new guard `if (sosOptions.length > 1 && !selectedSosOption)` never fires - clicking Create with nothing picked still shows the generic 'Product, Site and Quantity are required' toast (only because Site happens to be blank); (2) far worse - if the user types a Site manually, the submit goes through and POSTs logistic_relationship_uuid of option[0] (verified: intercepted body {"material_id":"HTBS-SPAIN","site_id":"P2",...,"logistic_relationship_uuid":"FA163E18-1C7B-1FE0-A99D-1FFB40FD7F05"}), i.e. the silent auto-pick the user explicitly asked to remove is still live and can write a wrong Production Model to SAP. Fix: `const selectedSosOption = selectedSosKey === "" ? null : sosOptions[Number(selectedSosKey)];` (or store the index as null and check `selectedSosKey === ""`).

action_items: FIX (HIGH): ProductionConfirmationPage.js selectedSosOption must be null when selectedSosKey is "" (Number("")===0 defeats the multi-SoS guard AND silently auto-picks option[0]'s logistic_relationship_uuid on submit when the user types a Site manually).
No other action needed: activeJobs localStorage resume, site-input clearing, site+warehouse-scoped locations (backend + both UIs) all verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Guard `!selectedSosOption` is unsafe with a string-index state; prefer an explicit `selectedSosKey === ""` sentinel check, and additionally block the POST when sosOptions.length > 1 && !logistic_relationship_uuid (defence in depth before a real SAP write).

rca_of_the_issue: Multi-SoS guard: selectedSosOption = sosOptions[Number(selectedSosKey)]. The 'nothing selected' sentinel is the empty string, and Number("") is 0, so the lookup silently returns the first option. Therefore both the new guard (runs first now, but its condition is false) and the intended 'no auto-pick' behaviour are bypassed; a manually-typed Site is enough to submit an order bound to option[0]'s Production Model. Reproduction: /production-confirmation -> enter name -> Product 'HTBS-SPAIN' -> Tab (2 options appear, none selected) -> type Site 'P2' -> Create Production Order -> POST fires with logistic_relationship_uuid FA163E18-1C7B-1FE0-A99D-1FFB40FD7F05.
